title: carpogymnia dryopteris var. pumila
intro: Carpogymnia dryopteris var. pumila, commonly known as the Dwarf Oak Fern, is a small, rare fern species found in the mountainous regions of East Asia. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may help alleviate respiratory issues and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Carpogymnia dryopteris var. pumila are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties, suggesting its potential use in treating various infections and inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
